# OAuth 2.1 相对 OAuth 2.0 做了哪些调整，OIDC 在其上增加了什么？引用规范原文。

以下报告仅综合已通过核验的研究结论，并为每项事实保留可回溯的证据引用。

## OAuth 2.1 (draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1) · Security requirements (PKCE, flows, token)

OAuth 2.1 将 PKCE 等 OAuth 2.0 核心未规定的特性设为必需。 [evidence:b522906f6189215b4bcf56f08c62936afec6082e908beef3]

## OAuth 2.1 (draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1) · Rationale or mechanism

OAuth 2.1 与 OAuth 2.0 兼容，但套用了已知最佳当前实践中的扩展和限制，因此 OAuth 2.0 核心未规定的 PKCE 在 OAuth 2.1 中成为必需。 [evidence:6bfe21c2e67d6758cd685e5871933335ea3784209824ec65]

## OAuth 2.1 (draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1) · Normative status and title

Internet-Draft: draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-10 Published: 9 January 2024 Intended Status: Standards Track [evidence:4c86a253bd1d46c046da671894304d0c110c31df575a3bd7]

## OIDC (OpenID Connect Core 1.0) · Security requirements (PKCE, flows, token)

使用 Authorization Code Flow 时，所有 token 均由 Token Endpoint 返回；该流程适合能在自身与 Authorization Server 之间安全保存 Client Secret 的 Client。 [evidence:922c2401b1b3c8a233a31b107e294d2527bcdd495fdbb8f4]

## OIDC (OpenID Connect Core 1.0) · Changes vs OAuth 2.0 / additions on OAuth 2.1

OIDC 将 Authentication Request 定义为使用 OpenID Connect 定义的扩展参数与 scope 的 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Request，用以请求认证 End-User [evidence:6007243e64b73ae4e5990c00bee3982e5ed12be817334acf]

## OIDC (OpenID Connect Core 1.0) · Normative status and title

OpenID Connect Core 1.0 (Sakimura, N., Bradley, J., Jones, M., de Medeiros, B., and C. Mortimore, “OpenID Connect Core 1.0,” December 2023.) [evidence:9859c15e575557b5cfb08d595600cd1cf447b4e98be33e13]

## 局限

- OIDC (OpenID Connect Core 1.0) · Rationale or mechanism：必需研究项未找到足够证据

## 引用核对

### OAuth 2.1 将 PKCE 等 OAuth 2.0 核心未规定的特性设为必需。

- 研究项：`OAuth 2.1 (draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1) · Security requirements (PKCE, flows, token)`
- 候选：`aec5a184-f8db-41c0-b5ca-dfce96fecfd2`
- Evidence: `evidence:b522906f6189215b4bcf56f08c62936afec6082e908beef3`
  - Exact quote: “Specifically, features not specified in OAuth 2.0 core, such as PKCE, are required in OAuth 2.1.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/34a426ee-6aa3-47f5-96ec-a6b47273a551/1df328d6685ac5f900590b1d565fffc070f13a22d4719a02e9b1469ed1e9d14f`
  - URL: https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-05.html

### OAuth 2.1 与 OAuth 2.0 兼容，但套用了已知最佳当前实践中的扩展和限制，因此 OAuth 2.0 核心未规定的 PKCE 在 OAuth 2.1 中成为必需。

- 研究项：`OAuth 2.1 (draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1) · Rationale or mechanism`
- 候选：`f5e7701f-96df-423e-96dc-7a3f696a054f`
- Evidence: `evidence:6bfe21c2e67d6758cd685e5871933335ea3784209824ec65`
  - Exact quote: “OAuth 2.1 is compatible with OAuth 2.0 with the extensions and restrictions from known best current practices applied. Specifically, features not specified in OAuth 2.0 core, such as PKCE, are required in OAuth 2.1.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/34a426ee-6aa3-47f5-96ec-a6b47273a551/1df328d6685ac5f900590b1d565fffc070f13a22d4719a02e9b1469ed1e9d14f`
  - URL: https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-05.html

### Internet-Draft: draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-10 Published: 9 January 2024 Intended Status: Standards Track

- 研究项：`OAuth 2.1 (draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1) · Normative status and title`
- 候选：`ff14020c-82c4-4670-9d4b-a537a2735b07`
- Evidence: `evidence:4c86a253bd1d46c046da671894304d0c110c31df575a3bd7`
  - Exact quote: “Internet-Draft: draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-10 Published: 9 January 2024 Intended Status: Standards Track”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/34a426ee-6aa3-47f5-96ec-a6b47273a551/56f44cd1e8af6f2430aad66accfd55c2f17f5d4078ecd1e8cb71d3cbdf7caa35`
  - URL: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-10

### 使用 Authorization Code Flow 时，所有 token 均由 Token Endpoint 返回；该流程适合能在自身与 Authorization Server 之间安全保存 Client Secret 的 Client。

- 研究项：`OIDC (OpenID Connect Core 1.0) · Security requirements (PKCE, flows, token)`
- 候选：`8937f23b-185b-45b3-b6cc-7cc826759891`
- Evidence: `evidence:922c2401b1b3c8a233a31b107e294d2527bcdd495fdbb8f4`
  - Exact quote: “This section describes how to perform authentication using the Authorization Code Flow. When using the Authorization Code Flow, all tokens are returned from the Token Endpoint.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/ac9c6bf3-6ac9-41f7-91fd-a7ea9a76ca53/70102dd619e23c9b30eabd8a0d0e8aa67562ce5bd37a66993811b08b6497310c`
  - URL: https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0-14.html

### OIDC 将 Authentication Request 定义为使用 OpenID Connect 定义的扩展参数与 scope 的 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Request，用以请求认证 End-User

- 研究项：`OIDC (OpenID Connect Core 1.0) · Changes vs OAuth 2.0 / additions on OAuth 2.1`

  - Exact quote: “OAuth 2.0 Authorization Request using extension parameters and scopes defined by OpenID Connect to request that the End-User be authenticated by the Authorization Server”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/9076e610-0313-41be-a73c-392756f80d06/ee25a5e6058fc759e0d6c40b8fcf1a7452080b638151a39467cf4fdcda8ffbd9`
  - URL: https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html

### OpenID Connect Core 1.0 (Sakimura, N., Bradley, J., Jones, M., de Medeiros, B., and C. Mortimore, “OpenID Connect Core 1.0,” December 2023.)
